officialTitle: Dabrafenib plus trametinib in patients with previously untreated BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer: an open-label, phase 2 trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Between April 16, 2014, and Dec 28, 2015, 36 patients were enrolled and treated with first-line dabrafenib plus trametinib.
design.notes: Cohort C (previously untreated) of a sequentially enrolled multicohort study.

clinicalQuestion: What is the activity of first-line dabrafenib plus trametinib in BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic NSCLC?

pico.population: Previously untreated metastatic BRAF V600E-mutant NSCLC

arms.label: Dabrafenib + trametinib
arms.dosing: Dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily plus trametinib 2 mg once daily
arms.doseSourceQuote: Patients received oral dabrafenib 150 mg twice per day plus oral trametinib 2 mg once per day

publications.title: Dabrafenib plus trametinib in patients with previously untreated BRAF-mutant metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer: an open-label, phase 2 trial.
publications.label: Cohort C primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: The proportion of patients with investigator-assessed confirmed overall response was 23 (64%, 95% CI 46-79), with two (6%) patients achieving a complete response and 21 (58%) a partial response.

safety.sourceQuote: All patients had one or more adverse event of any grade, and 25 (69%) had one or more grade 3 or 4 event.

The most common (occurring in more than two patients) grade 3 or 4 adverse events were pyrexia (four [11%]), alanine aminotransferase increase (four [11%]), hypertension (four [11%]), and vomiting (three [8%]).

clinicalImplications.text: Supports first-line dual BRAF/MEK inhibition with dabrafenib plus trametinib for BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic NSCLC.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Pyrexia is the hallmark toxicity of dabrafenib-trametinib — have a fever management plan.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 28919011. Abstract text strips the 'V600E' label; mutation identity taken from trial context.
